id="mailroom-reloaded-cap">The Mailroom Reloaded flow: a fixed main path from ingest to archive, with two deterministic gates. The classify gate can re-sort once, retry the sort, or park the document for human review. The extract gate can retry the extraction, send it to verification (judge, then arbiter), escalate to the boss agent, or park it for human review.</figcaption></figure>
